evidence: Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds the `testsubmitpackage` RPC method in `src/rpc/mempool.cpp`.
rationale: `testsubmitpackage` fills a documented gap requested by downstream callers for pre-flight package RBF and CPFP validation without mutating the mempool. As noted in the description, callers constructing fee-bumping packages currently lack a dry-run companion to `submitpackage`, partially resolving issue #32160.
